apt-cache.name: APT package cache
apt-cache.impact: Package archives re-download on the next install or upgrade.

journal-vacuum.name: Journal logs (vacuum to 100 MB)
journal-vacuum.impact: Journal entries beyond 100 MB are removed; recent logs stay.

apt-autoremove.name: Orphaned packages (autoremove --purge)
apt-autoremove.impact: Unneeded dependencies and their configuration are removed. Review the package list before confirming.

spotlight-rebuild.name: Spotlight index rebuild (/)
spotlight-rebuild.impact: Search results are unavailable while macOS rebuilds the index.

dism-cleanup.name: Windows component store cleanup (DISM)
dism-cleanup.impact: Superseded update payloads are removed. This action never uses /ResetBase, so installed updates stay uninstallable.
